questions.question: Describe the uses of compressed air in the food industry and the / contamination risks associated with compressed air systems.
questions.solution_html:
• Uses of compressed air
  • - Product conveying.
  • - Packaging.
  • - Pneumatic controls.
  • - Bottle cleaning.
  • Risks
  • - Microbial, oil, moisture and particulate contamination.
  • Controls
  • - Filtration, dryers, oil-free compressors and monitoring.
questions.final_answer: - Filtration, dryers, oil-free compressors and monitoring
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe allergen labelling requirements for packaged food products.

  • - Declare allergens in ingredient list.
  • - Use clear identification.
  • - Mention allergen sources.
  • - Comply with regulations.

questions.question: Discuss in detail the importance of hygienic site selection and zoning for food / processing premises.
questions.solution_html:
• Hygienic site selection and zoning
  • - Away from pollution sources and flooding.
  • - Adequate water and waste disposal.
  • - Proper segregation into low, medium and high-risk zones.
  • - Prevents cross-contamination and supports HACCP.
questions.final_answer: - Prevents cross-contamination and supports HACCP

questions.question: Explain FIFO and FEFO principles with reference to food safety and quality / control.
questions.solution_html:
• FIFO and FEFO
  • FIFO: First In First Out.
  • FEFO: First Expired First Out.
  • Importance
  • - Reduces spoilage.
  • - Maintains quality.
  • - Supports traceability.
  • - Improves inventory management.
questions.final_answer: - Improves inventory management
